If you're chronically constipated, stop taking laxatives. I'm a gastroenterologist. I've been treating gut disorders for over a decade. And I'm telling you, fiber isn't your problem. Wire isn't your problem. Stress isn't your problem. Your problem is biofilm. You have to explain what that actually means. Inside your colon right now, there's a colony of bad bacteria that have built themselves a protective shield. We call it a biofilm. It's a slimy, almost invisible armor that wraps around bacteria and shields them from your immune system, your stomach acid, in pretty much every medication we have. Once that biofilm forms, those bacteria are untouchable. And they don't just sit there quietly. They produce methane gas, which slows down the muscle contractions in your colon. That's the real reason you can't poop. Your colon isn't broken. It's being chemically paralyzed from the inside. This is also why your laxatives keep working less and less. None of them touch the biofilm. They just push stool past it. So the bacteria keep growing, the shield keeps getting thicker, and you keep needing more and more just to get the same result. That's the cycle most of my patients are stuffing when they walk into my office. Now, in serious cases, I do prescribe medication. But the truth is, most women I see don't need a prescription. They need to break the biofilm. And the most effective natural compound I found for that is fermented black garlic. Fermented black garlic is a powerful antimicrobial, antifungal, and immune booster. The active compound in it is called SAC, short for S-aldeal cysteine. SAC is one of the only natural compounds clinically shown to dissolve biofields in the gut, kill the bacteria hiding behind them, and protect your good bacteria at the same time. But the fermentation matters more than people realize. We'll properly ferment in black garlic has to age for a full 90 days under controlled heat and humidity. Gatswin SAC content multiplies almost six times. Most products on the market ferment for two weeks and call it black garlic. The SAC isn't there, which means the biofilm dissolving effect isn't there either. The brand I personally recommend to my patients is Wanol. It's the only one I've found that does the full 90-day fermentation with 6,000 milligrams per serving. One ingredient, no fillers, made and third-party tested in the U.S. How to take it? Two capsules every morning with food. Food helps the SAC absorb properly and reach the colon, which is where you need it to work. Most of my patients start nursing changes within the first two to three weeks. The bloating goes down, the pressure eases. Bowel movements start becoming more regular and complete on their own. I'm dropping the link for you below. They're 60% off right now and they offer a 60-day money-back guarantee. If you've been chronically constipated for years and nothing's worked, this is what I try before another prescription.
